episodes.synopsis: Teito Klein is a young student at the Barsburg Military Academy living in the same dorm with his best friend Mikage.
episodes.title: The Future of Painful Thoughts Is

episodes.synopsis: Three men are riding on hawkzile when Teito crashes into one of the men, Frau, and he is brought in to the Church.
episodes.title: Nostalgic Memories Accompany Pain

episodes.synopsis: Teito is about to leave the church when instead, he is brought to a place that seems to be the cafeteria by Frau.
episodes.title: My Innocent Child, Sleep Within the Light

episodes.synopsis: Teito talks with the old man, and tells him his wish to see Mikage.
episodes.title: To the Depths of the Earnest Prayer

episodes.synopsis: Teito is greeted by the sisters, who want to do his laundry.
episodes.title: Hot Tears, Gently Fill His Heart...

episodes.synopsis: The Church has its annual bazaar, and Teito, Mikage, and the sisters visit the bishops' shops.
episodes.title: The Path of Justice Leads to Light

episodes.synopsis: Mikage wonders whether or not he should leave the church, but is interrupted by Teito.
episodes.title: Does the Soul That Was Devoured by the Wings, Dream of Its Beloved Child?

episodes.synopsis: As Teito and Mikage talk, Labrador predicts that the “storm” will come very soon, and right now is the “calm.”
episodes.title: Half of His Soul Arouses a Sad Awakening

episodes.synopsis: Mikage, controlled by Ayanami, is still fighting Teito while Frau is on his way.
episodes.title: The Color of His Soul Will Be Forever...

episodes.synopsis: Teito decides to leave the church believing he should not cause anyone any more trouble, on the way he meets Castor who asks him if he knows the shinigami Zehel.
episodes.title: That Is But One Form of Atonement

episodes.synopsis: Teito, now staying in the church, wonders what he can do to atone for Mikage's death.
episodes.title: Atonement for Loved Ones Is...

episodes.synopsis: A man is seen making an agreement with a Kor, and being possessed by it.
episodes.title: The Darkness Called "Pain" Treads Ever Closer...

episodes.synopsis: Aldo, the criminal, is mysteriously murdered.
episodes.title: Down the Path of Light I See...

episodes.synopsis: Castor, Labrador, and Frau talk about the mysterious figure who attacked Castor.
episodes.title: A Reason to Fight Together... The Right to Be Called Brothers in Arms

episodes.synopsis: Teito states that he's putting all his effort into studying for the Bishop's Exam.
episodes.title: That Day, I Was Certainly With Him

episodes.synopsis: Labrador tells Castor and Teito that Fraus be given the death sentence.
episodes.title: Truth Lies in the Dark Abyss Where the Light Cannot Reach

episodes.synopsis: The boys are soon joined by Arch-Bishop Bastian, who tells them all about Frau's childhood.
episodes.title: The Family With Wings of Darkness, Enshrouded in Misery, Flies Down

episodes.synopsis: After Teitos has been knocked out, Hakuren continues to fight Bastian.
episodes.title: The One Who Must Be Forgiven Drowns in Darkness... The One Who Loves Him Is Filled With Tears

episodes.synopsis: Castor uses Kuroyuri to speak with Ayanami.
episodes.title: The One-Sided, Yet Never Dying Love Finds Itself...

episodes.synopsis: After being captured by Ayanami, Teito and Hakuren escape the military air ship and get support from Frau.
episodes.title: They Both Offer a Requiem

episodes.synopsis: The military found out about the Eye of Mikhail and its master, Teito, and decide to search for him.
episodes.title: Therefore, You Pass Through the Door of the Defeated

episodes.synopsis: After passing the first exam, Teito and Hakuren get to see the progress of others and how some fumble at the last challenge when their greedy nature makes them fail.
episodes.title: Led by the Light in the Water's Depth, He Spies Upon...

episodes.synopsis: The second exam resumes for the remaining trainees and comes in the worst form imaginable: the physical realization of their deepest fears.
episodes.title: Beyond the Heart's Darkness

episodes.synopsis: Ayanami appears in front of Teito and Teito wonders if Ayanami is just an illusion like before.
episodes.title: The Justice of Those Who Lack Love Is... Oh Heart That Is Stolen by Darkness, Forever...

episodes.synopsis: Teito uses the power of the Eye of Mikhail to summon Frau, Castor, Labrador, Lance, and the Black Hawks.
episodes.title: The Heart Is Lead by The Truth on the Other Side...
